d: Our client, a fast-growing global technology group, is seeking a Senior HR Business Partner to be the senior people partner for its Operations and Product functions while leading Reward and L&D for the whole group. It's a newly created role with a 70/30 split: 70% partnering your business area, 30% owning group-wide reward and learning.
q: li
10+ years in senior HRBP or people partnering roles in tech, product or fintech
li
Hands-on reward depth: job evaluation, benchmarking, pay reviews and incentive design
li
A track record designing and delivering L&D programmes and learning platforms
li
Org design and capability-building experience, ideally partnering Sales, Product or Operations
li
Experience across several countries or in a matrix organisation
li
Degree in HR, business or a related subject
p
Nice to have: CIPD Level 7 or MBA; reward experience across Europe, the Middle East and Asia; transformation or high-growth environment; reward (e.g. WorldatWork CCP) or coaching accreditation.

Partner senior Operations and Product leaders on capability, workforce planning, org design and change
li
Lead group reward: pay principles, annual pay review and bonus cycle, grading, job architecture and salary ranges
li
Design and run incentive and commission plans, and harmonise benefits across multiple countries
li
Lead pay equity and gender pay gap work, keeping the group compliant with emerging pay transparency rules
li
